stories.headline: A girl's lemonade stand has raised $5 million for kids
stories.summary: At 8, Payton Obert sold lemonade to buy toys for kids in hospital, like the teddy that helped her as a baby. She raised $768. 8 years on, her stands have sent $5 million in toys, food and clothes to kids.
stories.why: One small idea, repeated every summer, now helps kids across the country.

stories.headline: 3 new national parks now protect gliders, owls and platypuses
stories.summary: More than 250 square miles of forest in central Victoria became Mount Buangor, Pyrenees and Wombat-Lerderderg national parks, the state's first big new parks in 15 years, after a campaign that began in 2010.
stories.why: Greater gliders, powerful owls and rare plants keep their forest home for good.

stories.headline: A 2,300-year-old shipwreck still holds its sailors' cups
stories.summary: Off the Croatian island of Vis, divers found part of the hull, coins and rare Greek drinking cups and plates. Some vessels bear scratched markings that may name the sailors who owned them.
stories.why: Personal items bring ancient sailors back to life as real people.

stories.headline: A softball player found her long-lost sister on the other team
stories.summary: Adopted as a baby, Samantha Rensvold was told a rival player looked just like her. The name on the roster matched her birth sister's, and both moms confirmed the same birth mother and hospital.
stories.why: They even played volleyball in the same position, wearing the same number.

fun_fact: Greater gliders can glide up to 100 m in one leap between trees.
